text: The Patriots' roster underwent notable changes this week following their 26-19 victory over the Jets, as Romeo Doubs suffered a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch in the first quarter and was subsequently placed on injured reserve, while the team signed DB Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and made additional moves with practice squad signings of WR Ryan Miller, OL Jacob Rizy, and G Andrew Rupcich, along with the release of CB D'Shawn Jamison. Drake Maye's three touchdown passes helped the Patriots secure their third straight win and improve to 2-0 in the AFC East, though A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence following a right high ankle sprain was marked by a career-high three dropped passes in the victory. Head Coach Mike Vrabel's team has embraced a no-apologies mentality around winning, even as film analysis reveals areas for refinement in the Maye-Brown connection that produced the game-clinching throws despite the receiver's uncharacteristically shaky performance.
